summary.text: Ken Sweezey is a Republican state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 6th Plymouth District since January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

He was born in Hanson, Massachusetts, earned a bachelor's degree in forensic science from Loyola University Chicago, and worked as a project specialist at a small biotech company and as a latent fingerprint examiner.

paragraphs.text: Kenneth Sweezey was born in Hanson, Massachusetts, and graduated from Boston College High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in forensic science from Loyola University Chicago.
His career experience includes working as a project specialist at a small biotech company and as a latent fingerprint examiner for the St. Louis Metropolitan Police Department.

Sweezey succeeded Josh Cutler in the 6th Plymouth District seat, and Ballotpedia lists him as ranking minority member of the Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture and Labor and Workforce Development joint committees for 2025-2026.
